summary.zh: 台风杜苏芮于 2023 年 7 月 28 日上午在福建晋江沿海登陆，其残余环流随后给华北带来创纪录降水。此处是 7 月 26 日 00Z 起报的 GFS 原生 13 公里地面通量场，降水率与 10 米风场。
summary.en: Typhoon Doksuri made landfall near Jinjiang, Fujian on the morning of 28 July 2023; its remnants later brought record rainfall to northern China. This is the 26 July 00Z run on the native 13 km GFS surface-flux grid, precipitation rate and 10 m wind.
